system.description: Whenever someone dies and becomes a wraith within a half-mile of the Necromancer, she automatically senses the demise (this passive awareness may be ignored unless actively sought). By spending a Willpower Trait and succeeding on a Static Mental Challenge, the Necromancer learns the direction to the new wraith; further success narrows the distance, down to pinpointing the location to within a foot.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
